def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==1]
    if len(pts)>=2:
        (r1,c1),(r2,c2)=pts[:2]
        dr=r2-r1; dc=c2-c1
        import math
        g=math.gcd(abs(dr),abs(dc))
        if g:
            sr,sc=dr//g,dc//g
            for k in range(g+1):
                r,c=r1+k*sr,c1+k*sc
                out[r][c]=1
    return out
PY
